notes: Newly onboarded customer: benign-pattern suppression is NOT yet configured, deliberately. northwind-msp declares benign-inactive-skip and suppresses that traffic; this tenant does not, so the same alerts reach the model. That is why this tenant reports a non-zero false auto-action counter: 23 alerts of library noise are classified actionable, the model declines to repair anything and proposes open-ticket, and the gate allows that unattended because a ticket is reversible, zero blast radius and opted in. No infrastructure is touched. Kept as-is to show what the gate does for a tenant that has not been tuned.
